name: Tamayura
source:
Main character lives with two cousins and their appointed teacher.
At school he is forced to join sorcery club to study occultism. There he undertakes a dark-hearted supernatural case pushing him in the middle of two forces.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与两个表兄弟和他们指定的老师住在一起。
在学校他被迫加入巫术俱乐部学习神秘学。在那里，他接手了一个黑暗的超自然案件，将他推向了两种力量的中间。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
